jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) Local is a hard services-led, tailored facility management solution. We self-perform hard services while partnering with best-in-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high-level of downstream accountability, resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery.

In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best-in-Class services, including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience.

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Project Coordinator, you will provide support to project management operations, administration, and management for projects from start through completion.

  

This job is part of the Project Management function.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Ensure business policies and processes are effectively communicated and implemented within the Projects team.
* Ensure the provision of Health and Safe working conditions and that both clients and company health and safety policy and process is effectively implemented across the Business Unit.
* Effectively manage project teams financial commitments, raising POs, billing and managing financial.
* Develop project review pack.
* Management of all QHSE online reporting (to include Hazards, SmoWP, Audits).
* Completion of Audit Schedule.
* Ensure staffing structures on all contracts are updated when requested.
* Ad hoc event management upon request.
* Working with other Operational managers to ensure the collaborative development of the business, effective team working, and support to colleagues.
* Promoting and maintaining the core Values of CBRE Managed Services.
* Provision of guidance, advice, coaching and support to all other Project Coordinators within the business, where required to deliver best practice selection, training, assessment and recognition/reward.
* Delivering effective business communication through advice, review, and direct contribution to management and team meetings, briefings, consultation forums, correspondence, publicity, monthly and ad-hoc reporting and other publications, as appropriate.
* Provide a learning environment, and appropriate training and development planning. Ensure basic training needs are delivered, employees are fully competent to undertake their roles, and are able to reach their full future potential whilst updating and managing training matrix.
* Assist with all sales opportunities for the Business Unit. Supporting the Sales Team throughout the sales process.
* Ensure the completion of all Pre-Qualifying Questionnaires for the Business Unit.
* Work with our Sub-contractors and Head of Projects to ensure the best price for all sales opportunities
* Support of Mobilization as and when require.
* This is not a comprehensive list of job requirements, additional tasks may be included.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required. Minimum of 1-2 two years of related experience and/or training.
* Experience in administration or similar projects coordinator role
* Delivery of wider facilities management services is desirable
* Interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to inspire confidence
* Can manage a high degree of variability
* Results focused
* Excellent motivational and influencing skills, with high levels of personal integrity
* Organized, able to prioritize and deliver within high pressure, business critical environments
* Basic analytical skills and financial terms and principles.
* Capability of understanding and following general instructions and ability to solve problems.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word and Outlook.
* Decision making ability with a general understanding of procedures and company policies to achieve goals and deadlines.

**Why CBRE?**

We lead by example, guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build, and the world we live in. The more perspectives we have, the more dimensions we’re able to see. A culture of respect, integrity, service, and excellence shapes our approach to every opportunity.

Our competitive and comprehensive benefits program was designed to make sure you feel valued with benefits that support the mental, physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family.

Maintain your career momentum with the best tools and training in the industry. You’ll have everything you need to thrive in your role: challenging work, dedication to results, fast-paced assignments, and a culture of constant learning.

jobs.title: Research Program Manager, Research Infra and Training Frameworks
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

**About the Role**
------------------

Research Program Managers at Reflection are high-leverage leaders and operators who embed directly with research and infrastructure teams to accelerate the pace of frontier model development. They are not project trackers. They are force multipliers who bring clarity to ambiguity, drive decisions when the path forward is unclear, and ensure that the work happening across multiple teams connects into a coherent whole.

This role focuses on scaling our research infrastructure to continue to support massive, frontier-scale training runs across pre-training, mid-training, and post-training.

As a central mandate, you will help drive the scaling and continued evolution of our training stack. You will help gather and unify requirements, scope, and drive this scale-up rewrite of the trainer with the Research and GPU Infra engineers who build and operate our training frameworks. This role involves weaving requirements across all stages of our training pipeline: pre-training, mid-training workloads that pair the trainer with a high-throughput inference engine for RL, post-training, etc. We are looking for someone who has gone deep with GPU infrastructure teams to build training frameworks and has accumulated the scar tissue to prove it – you know firsthand which abstractions hold at 10K+ GPU scale and which ones don’t, and you can bring that judgment to a multi-quarter program of a training stack rewrite.

You bring a first-responder mentality. When things go sideways, you don't wait to be asked. You jump in, assess the situation, cut through noise, align the people who need to be aligned, and drive resolution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own cross-functional programs spanning training infrastructure across pre-training, mid-training, and post-training workstreams.
* Define and own the roadmap for training frameworks at Reflection
* Partner with infrastructure and research engineering leads to identify bottlenecks, define priorities, and ensure that infrastructure investments are directly tied to research velocity.
* Build and maintain visibility into training run health so that leadership and teams have the context they need to make fast, informed decisions.
* Create lightweight, durable processes for cross-team handoffs, config management, checkpoint workflows, and other coordination-heavy touchpoints that currently rely on ad hoc communication.
* Translate technical complexity into clear status updates and decision frameworks for engineering leadership and executives.

**About You**
-------------

* 7+ years of experience in technical program management, research operations, or infrastructure coordination, ideally in ML/AI or large-scale distributed systems environments.
* Deep technical knowledge to engage with engineers on topics like distributed training frameworks, GPU cluster architecture, scheduler behavior, networking, and storage systems. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand the systems to “speak the language”, i.e., to ask the right questions and identify risks early.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity, fast-moving environments. You create structure where there is none and drive clarity without waiting for permission.
* Track record of managing complex, multi-team programs with competing priorities and hard deadlines. You know how to make tradeoffs and you communicate them clearly.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across both deeply technical ICs and senior leadership. You build trust by being reliable, direct, and well-informed.
* Comfortable operating in crisis mode. You stay calm under pressure, you know how to prioritize when everything is on fire, and you follow through on the other side.
* Excited to build from zero to one. We are a small, fast-moving team and this role will help define how Research Program management Works at Reflection.
* Motivated by enabling researchers and engineers to build the world's most capable open-weight AI systems.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

* **Top-tier compensation:** Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.
* **Stock options:** Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.
* **Health & wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.
* **Meals:** Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.
* **Life & family:** 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.
* **Vacation days:** Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.
* **Sponsorship support:** We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.
* **Team building:** We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

***Export Control Notice:*** *This position may require access to technology or source code subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. * **Develop executive materials:** Create, organize, and maintain executive presentations, briefing materials, and leadership-facing resources to support effective communication and decision-making.
* **Improve administrative processes:** Identify opportunities to streamline administrative workflows, simplify recurring activities, and enhance executive office efficiency.
* **Support expense and adhoc activities:** Assist with expense tracking, reconciliation, and other ad hoc administrative responsibilities as needed.

* **Experience working with senior executives** , including preparing leadership presentations, and managing sensitive or confidential information.

jobs.title: Operations Associate, Insurance & Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
Healthcare is broken at the first step: patients can't find the right care, understand what it costs, or access the medications they need. Mochi Health is fixing this.

We're building an AI-driven marketplace that makes healthcare discoverable—connecting patients to the right providers, transparent pharmacy pricing, and affordable medications. Over the past few years, we've grown rapidly by combining clinical expertise with technology that actually works for real people, not just hospital systems.

Our platform does what legacy healthcare can't: it gives patients transparent pricing before they pay, personalized medication management that follows them across providers, and long-term access to their own medical records. We're proving that healthcare can be more affordable, more human, and far more intuitive than what exists today.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Health, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

**About The Role**
------------------

Mochi Health is a direct-to-patient telehealth company specializing in obesity medicine and expanding into primary care. With over 200,000 active patients, 500+ providers across 50 states, and a proprietary AI-enabled EMR, Mochi is building the infrastructure for a new model of virtual care delivery.  
  
Today we operate primarily on a cash-pay subscription model. Our Insurance & Payer Operations function is one of the company's most important strategic bets: building the clinical, operational, and technical infrastructure to accept insurance and unlock a new revenue stream, and it's the engine behind our expansion into primary care.  
About the Role  
  
We're looking for an independently driven, detail-oriented Operations Associate to support both our core clinical workflows and the buildout of our insurance program. This is a blended role: part of your time keeps clinical operations running smoothly, and part helps stand up and scale the insurance and payer side of the business as we grow.  
  
You'll learn the mechanics of payer contracting, credentialing, and compliant billing from the ground up, working closely with Clinical, Product, Care, and Data teams and our Insurance & Payer lead.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Optimize clinical workflows by identifying inefficiencies, implementing solutions, and improving care coordination.
* Analyze performance data using AI and other tools to track provider KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
* Act as a key liaison for providers, gathering feedback and streamlining workflows, and keep provider content and training resources up to date.
* Support day-to-day operations of the insurance program, coordinating across the credentialing team, billing operations, and external partners.
* Help manage provider credentialing and enrollment for insurance panels, tracking timely enrollment and re-credentialing across the payer network.
* Assist with payer contracting: organizing contract and rate information, preparing inputs for rate discussions, and tracking expansion into new payer networks.
* Support a team of agents that review billing and coding, helping monitor their output, surface documentation gaps and denial patterns, and escalate issues that create compliance or revenue risk.
* Monitor claims and vendor performance against collection, denial, and claims lifecycle targets.

**Job Announcement**

**Case Manager**

**Site/Program:** The Stay Over Program

**Reports to:** Program Manager

**Compensation:** $28 per hour, commensurate with experience. Full-time, non-exempt position. **Deadline:** Immediately interviewing on a rolling basis until position is filled.

**About the Organization:**

Mission Action has been growing rapidly, therefore, we have created a lot of new positions in different programs. Please consider joining our team to serve the communities.

Mission Action nurtures individual wellness and cultivates collective power among low-income and immigrant communities to create a more just society. As a multi-issue, multi-strategy organization, we work to improve lives on an individual level as well as affect broader social change by engaging in advocacy and community organizing. We work together across programs to address homelessness, lack of affordable housing, and to support immigrant rights in order to meet the complex needs of our communities and collectively address the root causes of suffering and injustice. To learn more about our organization's model and impact, we encourage you to watch the following video.

**Job Summary:**

Mission Action is seeking a qualified Family Case Manager to provide case management, family support, systems navigation, de-escalation, conflict resolution, mediation and referrals to approximately 20 families who are homeless and staying at the Stay Over Program. The Stay Over Program is a family shelter funded by the Department of HomelessnessSupportive Housing (HSH) which opened in November 2018 and is based at Buena Vista Horace Mann Community School. The Stay Over Program provides collaborative case management in partnership with SFUSD school social workers and HSH's Access Points to families experiencing homelessness or housing insecurity who have at least one child enrolled at San Francisco Unified School District. Year round emergency shelter and supportive services are provided to families at the family shelter that is operated from the gym at Buena Vista Horace Mann Community School. Approximately, three quarters of our families identify as Latinx. A key responsibility of the case manager is to provide the needed family support and systems navigation to ensure families are assessed at an Access Point where they can access the city's system of care and resources. The Family Case Manager will carry a caseload of about 20 chronically homeless families, many of whom have multiple barriers, including, but not limited to unemployment, substance use, mental and physical health conditions, domestic violence, and historical trauma. The case manager will provide support for families while they work towards securing stable housing. This position will also help families build their independent living skills so they are able to maintain permanent housing and will provide connections to community resources.

This is a great opportunity for a case manager who has experience working with Latinx families and families of color and cross-sector collaborations. Bilingual Spanish/English and experience providing culturally responsive and linguistically competent services is essential for the role of the case manager. School-based experience and experience working in a multi-cultural setting is highly desired. The Stay Over Program is a new model in San Francisco and an innovative strategy to support families experiencing homelessness to be able to have a permanent exit from homelessness and ensure that no families with school aged children are unsheltered.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Service Delivery**

* Support families in preparing for housing interviews or other meetings that impact their ability to obtain permanent housing.
* Assist families in responding to housing application rejections. Help families request reasonable accommodation or appeals when appropriate.
* Assist families in gathering and assembling related information and maintaining appropriate records and files.
* Responsible for gathering and compiling data and preparing timely periodic reports, as required by funders and collaborative partners.
* Maintain thorough and concise case notes.
* Embraces a growth mindset in the work with families and is committed to Family Support Principles and the practice of working with families to build Protective Factors
* Attend and participate in weekly case management meetings and partner meetings.

**Outreach and Engagement:**

* Provide field-based work for families that may involve traveling to various community programs and locations
* Respond to the needs of families, including emergency situations - food, health, income, transportation, school related matters, child welfare issues, etc.
* Connect families with appropriate resources and referrals for housing, child care, mental health, primary care, substance recovery, physical health care, educational programs, financial assistance, employment, housing advocacy, socialization activities and other services partnership development

**Partnership DevelopmentCollaboration:**

* Develop rapport and build an ongoing relationship with families via regular and consistent contact
* Develop rapport and strong working relationships with staff at the Access Points, HSH, and SFUSD social workers and administrators, and partner organizations
* Establish communication links with and for families - phone/cell phone, mailing address, e-mail, meeting, and social support contacts
* Help families link with clinical care management and other service resources as needed and desired
* Provide psychological/emotional preparation and support for families around obtaining housing - realistic expectations of wait times, affordable housin

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.

* Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.

* A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics on their work measures. Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

jobs.title: Research Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash's current and future products.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Research Operations Manager to be the operational backbone of our research team, and a driving force behind DoorDash's commitment to customer obsession. Every great product decision starts with a real voice: a Dasher, a merchant, a customer. You'll own the systems, tools, vendors, and AI-powered processes that get those voices in front of the people building for them, faster and at greater scale. You'll also champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, so the research practice keeps getting better along with our understanding of the people we serve. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of research, operations, and technology, built for someone who sees friction before it's surfaced and treats it as theirs to solve.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Vendor & Procurement Management**: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of research vendor relationships — from sourcing and evaluation through contract negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance review. You'll manage relationships with research tool providers, recruiting agencies, transcription and analysis services, and other third-party partners. You'll establish clear SLAs, hold vendors accountable, and continuously evaluate the market for better options.

**Budget Management:** Own the research team's budget: track spend, forecast needs, manage purchase orders, and ensure resources are allocated to the highest-impact work. You'll build visibility and reporting so research leaders can make informed investment decisions, and you'll identify opportunities to optimize spend without sacrificing research quality.

**Participant Recruiting** Lead the strategy and execution of participant recruiting across studies — managing panels, recruiting vendors, and internal databases to ensure the team has access to the right participants at the right time. You'll develop screeners, coordinate scheduling, manage incentives and compliance, and build systems that make recruiting faster and less effort-intensive for researchers.

**AI-Powered Research Tooling:** Partner with researchers, engineering, design to evaluate, build, maintain, and scale AI-based tools that accelerate the research process, from automated synthesis and analysis pipelines to intelligent tagging, search, and knowledge management. You'll bring a practical, iterative approach: shipping tools that solve real problems, gathering feedback, and improving them over time.

**Culture of Experimentation** Be a visible champion for experimentation within the research team. This means creating the conditions (psychological safety, lightweight processes, shared frameworks) that make it easy for researchers to try new methods, tools, and approaches. You'll run retrospectives, document and share learnings, and help the team build an institutional memory around what works.

**Operations & Scalability** Design and maintain the operational infrastructure that keeps the research practice running smoothly: research repositories, documentation standards, onboarding materials, team rituals, and the tooling stack. As the team and its ambitions grow, you'll proactively identify bottlenecks and build solutions before they become problems. You will also partner across brands/regions to extend research operations infrastructure globally, adapting for local legal and market requirements.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in research operations, UX operations, or a closely related role
* Experience managing contractors or full-time employees, including setting priorities, providing feedback, supporting development, and ensuring delivery
* Demonstrated experience managing research vendors and procurement processes
* Experience owning and forecasting operational or project budgets
* Experience with research repositories and recruiting platforms (UserTesting, Qualtrics, etc.)
* Familiarity with prompt engineering or working with LLMs in a research or operations context. You don't need to code, but you're excited to build tools using AI and have strong intuitions about what to build and when
* A systems thinker who can zoom out to see inefficiencies and zoom in to fix them
* Strong communicator who can influence without authority and build trust across research, product, and engineering teams
* High degree of self-direction. You spot problems before they're surfaced to you and move quickly to address them

**Why This Role**
-----------------

Research Operations is often the difference between a research team that produces insights and one that produces impact. In this role, you'll have real ownership, a team that values your craft, and the opportunity to shape how a research practice operates at scale, including on the frontier of AI-assisted research.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations
jobs.description:
Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world.

Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. We are now looking to bring on talented team members who are the best at what they do to help us make Hubble a reality for the world.

**This is a****hybrid****full-time** **position based in Seattle, WA or San Francisco, CA**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We're looking for a **Senior Program Manager, Mission Operations** to own two of the most consequential parts of Hubble's space business: the programs we run through our spacecraft vendors and contract manufacturers, and the day-to-day operation of the constellation those programs deliver.

You will be Hubble's single accountable owner for our spacecraft bus and contract manufacturing partners, running those programs end to end — commercial terms, design reviews, qualification campaigns, hardware delivery, launch integration, and on-orbit commissioning — and holding partners to what they committed to. In parallel you will lead Hubble's Mission Operations function: setting technical direction for how we operate our satellites and payloads, building the team and tooling to scale from a handful of vehicles to a production fleet. It suits someone who has lived on both sides of the table — **a strong space program manager with genuine engineering depth, credible in a vendor review and steady in an anomaly call.**

This is a full-time, supervisory position reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer. Seattle, WA is strongly preferred; remote will be considered for the right candidate. Expect regular travel to partner facilities.

**AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS**

* **A Sense of Urgency**: Lead projects from concept to reality, rapidly and effectively
* **First Principles Engineering**: Have a strong understanding of the whys behind the "what's"; have the ability to extrapolate from first principles to complex system design
* **High Learning Agility**: Love to learn; have a grounded approach to recognizing your weaknesses and take the initiative to brush up on and sharpen your engineering foundations to better collaborate with your teammates with different backgrounds
* **System-Level Design and Analysis**: Understand the requirements flow down process and be able to quickly iterate on evolving requirements
* **Excellent Communication Skills**: Effectively convey ideas and communicate technical topics with engineering, build staff, and operations; run self-directed design reviews and participate in reviews of parallel systems
* **Anticipation of Needs**: Identify problems, think creatively, and rapidly produce reliable and cost-effective solutions to meet the ever growing and changing needs of an early-stage company

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years in space or satellite systems, spanning both program management and hands-on engineering or operations.
* Demonstrated ownership of a spacecraft, payload, or satellite program through a full lifecycle — design, qualification, delivery, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Proven experience managing external spacecraft vendors, contract manufacturers, or prime/subcontractor relationships with real contract management, schedule execution, and cost accountability.
* Engineering depth sufficient to evaluate vendor technical work independently and push back credibly — spacecraft systems, RF communications, or a closely adjacent discipline.
* Experience with satellite or payload operations, including telemetry analysis, commanding, anomaly triage, and spacecraft / ground segment interfaces.
* Strong program management fundamentals: integrated scheduling, risk management, configuration control, and milestone-driven delivery.
* Experience leading structured technical reviews (SRR through ORR) with internal teams and external partners.
* Excellent written communication; able to produce concise, decision-oriented material for executives and investors.
* Supervisory or team leadership experience, or clear readiness to take it on.
* U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (ITAR compliant).

**STRONGLY DESIRED**

* Experience standing up or scaling a mission operations organization.
* Familiarity with ground segment service providers, RF chain architecture, front-end processors, and communications security.
* Background in small satellite or commercial constellation programs, especially in a production or multi-vehicle context.
* Experience with launch services procurement and mission integration.
* Exposure to satellite regulatory and licensing processes, and to export control requirements (ITAR/EAR).
* Comfort with Jira, Confluence, and software development workflows for requirements and user story management.
* Experience in a startup or rapid-iteration environment, and a track record of adding rigor without adding bureaucracy.
* Engineering degree in aerospace, electrical, mechanical, or a related field. PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.

Salary: $145,000 - $235,000 (commensurate with experience)  
Comprehensive Benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, & HSA options

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Janene’s Bridal Boutique | Alameda & San Francisco, CA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Schedule:** Weekends Required  
**Location:** Primarily Alameda, CA, with on-site management at our San Francisco location as needed

**About Janene’s Bridal Boutique**

At Janene’s Bridal Boutique, we believe finding your wedding dress should be one of the most memorable and special experiences of your wedding journey. Our mission is to help every bride discover a dress that reflects her vision, celebrates her individuality, and makes her feel absolutely beautiful.

We pride ourselves on providing an exceptional, personalized, luxury bridal shopping experience. We are looking for a passionate, organized, and results-driven Operations Manager to help lead our two boutique locations in Alameda and San Francisco.

**Position Overview**

The Operations Manager will oversee the day-to-day operations, performance, and overall success of both Janene’s Bridal Boutique locations, with a primary focus on our Alameda location. Both boutiques operate under similar business models and standards, and the Operations Manager will be responsible for ensuring consistency, efficiency, and excellence across both locations.

This individual will work closely with the CEO to execute business goals, strengthen operational systems, develop and motivate our team, and ensure every aspect of the business is running smoothly.

The ideal candidate is a natural leader who thrives in a fast-paced retail environment, has a strong business mindset, and understands the importance of delivering a high-touch customer experience. Experience in luxury retail, bridal, fashion, hospitality, or specialty retail management is highly desirable.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership, build a strong team, improve processes, and make a meaningful impact on a growing small business.

**Job Purpose**

The purpose of the Operations Manager is to lead and inspire a team that helps brides find their dream dress while ensuring the business operates efficiently and profitably.

This person will serve as the bridge between leadership, sales, administration, inventory, and alterations. They will proactively identify operational challenges, develop creative solutions, establish accountability, and ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply oversee daily tasks, but takes initiative, anticipates needs, solves problems, and consistently looks for ways to improve the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Multi-Location Operations & Leadership

* Oversee the daily operations of both the Alameda and San Francisco boutiques.
* Maintain a primary presence at the Alameda location while regularly supporting and overseeing the San Francisco team.
* Ensure both locations follow consistent operating procedures, service standards, and company policies.
* Create systems and processes that improve efficiency, communication, and accountability across both locations.
* Ensure all departments are functioning seamlessly, including sales, administration, inventory, and alterations.
* Identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions.
* Ensure opening, closing, daily checklists, and operational procedures are consistently completed.
* Monitor staffing needs and ensure appropriate coverage at both locations.
* Conduct regular check-ins and communicate with the leadership team at each location.

2. Sales Performance & Business Growth

* Work closely with the CEO to establish and execute sales goals and business objectives.
* Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, average transaction values, and other key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Develop strategies to increase sales, appointment bookings, customer retention, and overall profitability.
* Train and coach sales consultants to maximize their performance and deliver exceptional bridal experiences.
* Identify opportunities to increase store traffic and attract new customers.
* Review sales reports and identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Hold the team accountable for meeting individual and store-wide sales goals.
* Help create sales initiatives, promotions, and strategies that align with the boutique's brand and business goals.

3. Team Management & Development

* Lead, motivate, and inspire a positive, professional, and customer-focused team.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop new employees.
* Establish clear expectations and accountability for all team members.
* Conduct regular employee check-ins, performance reviews, and coaching sessions.
* Identify employee strengths and areas for improvement and create development plans.
* Address employee performance concerns, scheduling issues, and workplace conflicts professionally.
* Foster a collaborative environment where team members support one another.
* Create a culture of ownership, professionalism, positivity, and exceptional service.
* Lead by example through strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail.

4. Alterations Department Oversight

* Ensure the alterations department operates efficiently and maintains high standards of organization and cleanliness.
* Oversee alterations workflows, timelines, scheduling, and communication.
* Ensure seamstresses have the necessary supplies, materials, tools, and resources to perform their work.
* Monitor alterations progress and help prevent delays or missed deadlines.
* Ensure clear communication between sales consultants, seamstresses, and brides.
* Help resolve alterations-related customer concerns and scheduling challenges.
* Establish systems to track dresses, fittings, deadlines, and outstanding alterations.
* Ensure the alterations workspace remains clean, organized, and professional.

5. Customer Experience & Service Excellence

* Ensure every bride receives an exceptional, personalized, and memorable shopping experience.
* Maintain the boutique's luxury service standards across both locations

jobs.title: Freelance - Sr. Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:

--------------

Tatcha is a skincare brand rooted in timeless Japanese wisdom, offering transformative yet kind-to-skin formulas that marry Japanese botanicals with clinical ingredients. Our formulation philosophy is informed by the Japanese concept hinou dokon, which means "skin-mind same root"—an acknowledgement of the powerful connection between the skin and the brain. Guided by the mission to care for people through their skin, Tatcha takes a holistic approach to skincare from concept to formulation to clinical evaluation, offering skincare rituals that benefit both skin and mind, while emphasizing the importance of mindfulness to skin health.

**The Opportunity**

Tatcha is a modern luxury Japanese skincare brand. Our purpose: to inspire self-love as a quiet, lasting revolution. Behind every campaign, every launch, every carefully considered digital experience is a framework of clarity — someone who understands how to move work from idea to execution without losing what made the idea worth pursuing in the first place.
  
  
We are looking for a Freelance Senior Creative Project Manager who brings both structural rigor and creative fluency to one of the most connective roles in our organization.

During their time on assignment with Tatcha, this person will own Packaging projects from brief through artwork development, approvals, mechanical release, and final production handoff, while also managing broader Creative initiatives across Brand, Digital, E-Commerce, and campaigns based on business priorities.

The Freelance Senior Creative Project Manager will also partner closely with Creative Operations to help build and improve Wrike workflows, templates, routing, approvals, and reporting. This role reports to the Director, Creative Production & Operations.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational judgment, understands how creative work moves through a complex organization, and can bring structure, clarity, and momentum without slowing the work down.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Project Management & Execution

* Own end-to-end project management for assigned Creative initiatives, from intake and briefing through execution and final delivery.
* Manage complex Creative projects across multiple workstreams, with a primary focus on Packaging.
* Build and manage realistic timelines, milestones, dependencies, and critical delivery dates.
* Ensure briefs, inputs, and requirements are complete and actionable before work begins.
* Coordinate reviews, feedback, approvals, routing, and final handoffs across Creative and cross-functional partners.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and proactively identify risks, delays, scope changes, or resource conflicts.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines and help drive clear decisions around priorities, ownership, sequencing, and deliverables.

Packaging

* Serve as the primary operational project lead for Packaging, driving alignment on timelines, ownership, routing, and key decisions across cross-functional teams.
* Manage key Packaging inputs and dependencies including copy, translations, dielines, whites, mechanicals, proofs, and final production files.
* Partner closely with Creative, Product Development, Engineering, Procurement, Regulatory, Legal, Production, and Brand Marketing.
* Manage artwork routing and approvals, ensuring the right stakeholders are involved at the right stages.
* Proactively surface missing inputs, conflicting information, or risks before they impact timing, quality, or cost.
* Support final artwork release and production handoff.

Cross-Functional & Creative Operations

* Manage select Creative projects across Brand, Digital, E-Commerce, campaigns, and other business priorities based on team needs and capacity.
* Serve as a key connector across Creative and cross-functional teams, providing clear visibility into project status, risks, decisions, and upcoming milestones.
* Partner with Creative Operations to build, test, and improve Wrike workflows across Packaging and broader Creative projects.
* Help develop standardized templates, timelines, intake processes, routing, approvals, dashboards, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve visibility, and reduce unnecessary rounds or handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in creative project management, creative operations, packaging project management, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience managing Packaging projects from concept through artwork development, mechanical release, and production is required.
* Experience within beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fragrance, luxury, or consumer goods preferred.
* Proficiency in Wrike, with demonstrated experience building and optimizing workflows, templates, routing, approvals, timelines, and reporting.
* Exceptional organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing the detail.
* A self-starter who can operate independently, adapt quickly, and bring others along with them.
* Strong cross-functional instincts — comfortable working across brand, marketing, e-commerce, design, and copy teams globally.

**Who You Are**

* You find satisfaction in the structure that makes great work possible. You are the person who reads a brief and immediately sees the dependencies, the risks, and the path forward. You communicate with precision — to creatives, to marketers, to leadership — and you adjust your register without adjusting your standards.
* You are not here to police timelines. You are here to protect the work.

* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, procurement timelines, and construction deliverables.

* Lead owner meetings, subcontractor coordination meetings, and project progress reviews.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, budget concerns, subcontractor issues, and construction-related challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, safety regulations, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
* Manage project closeout activities, including punch lists, inspections, commissioning coordination, warranties, and turnover documentation.
* Maintain strong client relationships and support future business development opportunities.
* Provide leadership, training, and mentorship to Project Engineers and Assistant Project Managers.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of commercial construction project management experience.
* Strong experience managing ground-up commercial construction, tenant improvements, renovations, or technically complex construction projects.
* Background in life sciences, healthcare, advanced technology, education, civic, or similar commercial construction environments.
* Proven ability to manage projects from preconstruction through final closeout.
* Experience overseeing project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, and procurement.
* Strong understanding of construction methods, materials, structural systems, and building components.
* Experience managing project financials, including cost forecasting, change orders, billing, and profitability.
* Knowledge of commercial construction trades, including complex mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, civil, and MEP drawings.
* Strong understanding of construction scheduling, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organization, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction project management software.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience managing life sciences laboratories, healthcare facilities, technology campuses, educational buildings, or other technically demanding commercial projects.
* Background in ground-up construction, specialized tenant improvements, and occupied-facility renovations.
* Experience with design-build, design-assist, negotiated contracts, or other collaborative project delivery methods.
* Familiarity with complex MEP systems, laboratory infrastructure, process utilities, and commissioning requirements.
* Experience managing projects with challenging site logistics, accelerated schedules, or extensive stakeholder coordination.
* Knowledge of BIM/VDC coordination, sustainable construction practices, and LEED requirements.
* Proficiency with Procore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar construction management software.
* OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
* Experience managing multiple projects or large project teams.

* Treats customers, coworkers, and installers with professionalism and respect.
* Can work independently while recognizing that teamwork makes everyone more successful.

What's in It for You?

**Estimator / Project Coordinator**

Job Description

**Department**

Estimating & Project Administration

Burlingame, CA (hybrid or in-office)

Full-time

$98,000 – $108,000 per year, plus performance bonus

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Estimator / Project Coordinator prices commercial flooring and surface services work, helps win it, and then carries each awarded project from contract through closeout. This role owns the bid and the project paperwork, working closely with Operations, which manages crews and field performance, and with Accounting, which handles invoicing and collections.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Estimating and Bid Management**

* Review incoming bid invitations, accept bids, and assign them to the appropriate estimator or division.

* Prepare estimates using takeoffs, vendor quotes, and the company labor rate sheet; keep the rate sheet current.

* Request and follow up on pricing from suppliers and vendors by phone and email.

* Incorporate drive time and overtime into labor pricing.

* Prepare RFIs, manage bid deadlines, and submit complete proposals on time.

* Enter each bid in Salesforce with the client project manager’s contact information and the latest proposal.

**Contract Award Review**

* Verify that the company’s legal name, scopes of work, and dollar values on each contract match the awarded bid.

* Confirm inclusions and exclusions are clearly stated and priced, including power/generators, floor protection, floor preparation, demolition, and adhesive removal.

* Compare scheduled days and work dates against the time required to perform the work.

* Track pre-lien notices.

**Project Coordination**

* Schedule job starts and project timelines with clients and Operations.

* Review contracts in detail, route them through DocuSign as needed, and negotiate or correct changes with clients.

* Obtain contact information for each client’s project manager and superintendent.

* Obtain insurance requirements from the general contractor or contract and coordinate certificates of insurance with the company’s insurance broker.

* Prepare, submit, and track submittals and samples through approval.

* Order materials for awarded projects.

* Attend Project Labor Agreement (PLA) meetings.

* Upload budgets, contracts, and project documents to Procore.

* Collect work tags from Operations, prepare change order requests (CORs), and track them through approval.

* Maintain budgeted production rates, using closeout feedback from Operations to refine future estimates.

* Complete project closeout documentation.

**Billing Coordination**

* Notify Accounting when billing milestones are reached, including submittals sent, materials ordered, mockups completed, stages of work completed, and final completion.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 3 to 5 years of estimating experience in commercial flooring, finishes, or a related trade.

* Working knowledge of takeoffs, labor productivity, and material costs.

* Ability to read and interpret contracts, scopes of work, insurance requirements, and prevailing-wage or PLA provisions.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Procore, DocuSign, Microsoft Excel, and email.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Clear written and verbal communication with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Simpro or QuickBooks.

* Procore certification or formal estimating training.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is primarily office-based, with occasional job walks and PLA meetings at active construction sites, which may require walking on uneven surfaces and wearing personal protective equipment. Bid deadlines may require extended hours during busy periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay: $98,000 – $108,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance bonus: 5% to 10% of base pay, tied to bid success at target margin, on-time submissions, and contract and insurance turnaround.

* Medical insurance, with the company covering the majority of the employee-only premium.

* 15 days of paid time off plus paid company holidays.

* 401(k) with a 3% to 4% company match.

* Reimbursement of necessary business expenses, including mileage and phone.

* $1,000 to $1,500 annual professional development allowance.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Manager, GMP Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth-stage life-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027.

CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.

Yowei is seeking a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to supervise daily QA activities supporting peptide manufacturing, laboratory operations, materials, documentation, and cGMP compliance. This person will manage QA staff and directly support document review, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:

Job Duties:

* Supervise daily QA work, assign priorities, review completion, train staff, and provide practical guidance on cGMP documentation and quality-system requirements.
* Review executed batch records, laboratory records, equipment and cleaning records, logbooks, labels, and supporting documentation for completeness and compliance.
* Manage or support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, nonconformances, complaints, and effectiveness checks; ensure actions are documented and completed on time.
* Coordinate document control, SOP issuance, periodic review, archival, forms, templates, and controlled-copy practices.
* Support employee training assignments, completion tracking, qualification records, and documentation of GMP readiness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, QC, Materials, Facilities, Validation, Regulatory, and management to resolve quality issues and prevent avoidable delays.
* Provide QA review and approval of validation plans, risk assessments, protocols, reports, and qualification documentation for facilities, utilities, equipment, processes, cleaning, analytical methods, and software systems.
* Work with system owners to maintain a practical validation assessment plan and address gaps in current or legacy validation documentation using documented risk-based decisions.
* Support supplier qualification, material-status decisions, quality agreements, vendor documentation, and supplier corrective actions as assigned.
* Manage or support customer-complaint investigations and approved recall or product-withdrawal procedures, including documentation, reconciliation, and authorized notifications.
* Conduct or coordinate internal audits, floor observations, documentation reviews, and follow-up of findings.
* Prepare QA records and subject-matter experts for customer audits and regulatory inspections; track requests, responses, observations, and commitments.
* Monitor practical QA metrics such as overdue investigations, CAPAs, change controls, document reviews, training, batch-record review, and recurring documentation errors.
* Escalate product-quality, patient-safety, data-integrity, compliance, and release risks promptly to authorized Quality leadership.
* Improve QA workflows, templates, training, and quality-system usability without transferring QC laboratory or Manufacturing ownership into QA.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of Quality Assurance or closely related cGMP experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, peptide, API, sterile, medical-device, or other regulated manufacturing.
* 2+ years of supervisory, lead, or functional-management experience, including work assignment, training, review, and employee development.
* Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness.
* Working knowledge of cGMP documentation, data integrity, traceability, quality risk, and cross-functional escalation.
* Working knowledge of applicable FDA and ICH expectations and risk-based validation practices.
* Strong judgment, written communication, investigation, organization, and follow-through skills.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program

jobs.title: Case Manager II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**About us:**

As a Federally Qualified Health Center in Northern California with over 50 years of dedicated service to the community, LifeLong serves over 66,000 patients in the East Bay Area's socio-economically underserved regions. We provide medical, dental, behavioral health, and school-based services at more than 15 primary care sites across Oakland, Berkeley, and West Contra Costa County. From opening a residential respite program for homeless persons discharged from hospital to offering free testing to the community, we are innovative and responsive to our times' social and medical needs. We provide an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and with which our patients can identify. To this end, we seek candidates who reflect the diversity of the East Bay communities we serve.

**Benefits:**

We offer excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, dependent and domestic partner coverage, 403(b) retirement savings plan, and paid time off.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team-oriented environment

**Company:**

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network

**Work Shift:**

8 Hour (days) (United States of America)

**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

40

**Job Description Summary:**

The Clinical Practice Specialist serves as the organizational lead for ambulatory reprocessing, Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) compliance, and regulatory readiness programs across the medical network. The position functions as a subject matter expert responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving programs that support regulatory compliance, patient safety, and clinical quality.  
  
This role exercises substantial discretion and independent judgment in partnership with the clinical practice leaders in interpreting regulatory requirements, evaluating compliance risks, developing corrective action plans, and advising operational and clinical leaders regarding compliance obligations and patient safety concerns. The incumbent is authorized by the clinical practice to develop standards, policies, training programs, auditing processes, and performance improvement initiatives that impact multiple clinical sites and service lines.  
  
The Clinical Practice Specialist works collaboratively with clinical operations, infection prevention, laboratory services, quality, risk management, and practice leadership to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, accrediting body, and manufacturer requirements.

**Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:**

**Pay Range: $36.00 - 45.00 - 54.00**

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

Regulatory Readiness & Accreditation

* Leads and coordinates ambulatory regulatory readiness activities across assigned clinics and service lines.
* Develops and maintains readiness plans, accreditation tools, tracer methodologies, mock surveys, and audit processes per guidelines as directed by clinical practice leadership.
* Conducts compliance assessments and gap analyses to identify regulatory vulnerabilities.
* Evaluates findings and independently develops corrective and preventive action plans.
* Tracks organizational readiness for regulatory surveys, inspections, and accreditation reviews.
* Serves as a resource during surveys conducted by regulatory and accrediting agencies.
* Monitors changes in regulatory requirements and proactively implements needed program modifications.

CLIA Program Administration

* Manages the operational oversight of ambulatory CLIA certificates and associated regulatory requirements.
* Coordinates CLIA applications, renewals, modifications, and supporting documentation.
* Maintains network-wide inventories of laboratory testing sites, testing complexity levels, and compliance requirements.

=======================================

**Montclair Pet Hospital | Oakland, CA**  
**Full-time | $22–$28 per hour**  
**Monday–Thursday | Four 10-hour shifts | 7:30 am–6:00 pm**

**At Montclair Pet Hospital, we believe pets and people deserve better care.**

We're looking for a friendly, compassionate and organised **Client Service Representative (CSR)** to join our team in the heart of Oakland's Montclair neighbourhood.

As the first point of contact for our clients and their pets, you'll play an important role in creating a welcoming, reassuring experience from the moment they walk through our doors or pick up the phone.

You'll be joining a collaborative veterinary team that values great communication, teamwork and delivering thoughtful, personalised care. jobs.title: ABA Therapy Program Manager

The Program Manager will provide clinical skills instruction and behavior reduction protocols based upon the principles of Applied Behavior Analysis to children with Autism and related developmental disabilities in the home, community, school, and clinic settings. The Program Manager will collect data on programs, assist with parent training, and implement programs developed by a Board Certified Behavior Analyst which are individualized for each client.  
  
Essential components of this position are listed below but are subject to change at the discretion of Behavior Nation LLC. This job description describes essential job functions but does not provide an exhaustive list of duties that may be assigned.  
  
**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Deliver clear, concise, constructive, and actionable communications, insights, and feedback to staff and client families with professionalism, HR-compliant language, and a spirit of customer service.

* Respect the time of colleagues and client families by maintaining a punctual, consistent, reliable schedule, and inspiring others to reflect the same attitude and share the commitment.
* Provide training and ongoing support to caregivers and family members tailored to support their communication, learning styles, and cultural needs.
* Maintain professional, regular, and effective (timely and accurate) communication with client families and all colleagues (administrative and clinical).
* Produce clinical and administrative duties and paperwork with accuracy and timeliness and in compliance with the contracted (billable) hours allotted.
* With a spirit of leadership and teamwork, attend and lead the clinical team and training meetings.
* Comply with the company’s policies, procedures, timelines, and budgets.

* Excellent interpersonal skills: Builds rapport with clients and with colleagues, and cultivates rapport between the clinical team and the client's family.

* Ability to give and receive constructive feedback.
* Bilingual skills are valued.

* Must be able to lift and carry clients with adaptive equipment.

* Must have the manual dexterity to perform specific computer and electronic device functions, and paper means for data collection.
* Must be physically present at the assigned job location, which may include home, school, community, and clinical placements.
* Must be able to receive detailed information through oral communication.
* Must have visual acuity to read and comprehend written communication through a computer, electronic devices, and paper means.
* Must have reliable transportation and be willing and able to travel between different job sites within the San Francisco Bay Area.
* Must maintain a professional appearance with regard to clothing, grooming, hair, and make-up.
* Must pass a criminal background check (Clean DOJ/FBI record).
* Must have or be able to acquire First Aid/CPR Certification.
* Must have or be able to successfully complete RBT certification if does not have BCaBA certification.
* Must pass TB test, and have up-to-date immunization record (per company requirements).
* Strong interest in working with individuals impacted by neurodevelopmental disorders.

**Experience:**

* Experience working with children ages 18 months and older providing in a classroom or 1:1 setting.
* Experience implementing the principles of Applied Behavior Analysis.
* Educational, Speech, or Allied Health Services experience.

**Education:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree + 12-semester units in applied behavior analysis + 1 year of experience in implementing behavior modification intervention services OR
* Bachelor’s Degree + 2 years of experience in implementing behavior modification intervention services + RBT Certification OR
* Board Certified Associate Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) certification.

**Preferred**:

* Master’s degree in Psych
