jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Opportunity:**

As a key member of the interdisciplinary clinic team, the Clinical Care Coordinator (CCC) plays an essential role in supporting members' daily experiences and sense of belonging at Amae Health. You'll help create a warm, engaging environment by facilitating group activities, wellness programming that encourage connection and growth. Working closely with our clinicians and staff, you'll share insights and contribute to a collaborative approach to member care. In addition to member engagement, you'll support clinic operations by managing communications, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with daily workflows. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented role, ideal for someone passionate about mental health, eager to learn, and excited to make a meaningful impact in their community.

**What You Will Work On:**

* **Member Engagement & Support -** Facilitate groups, arts and crafts, and recreational activities to enhance the member experience at Amae Health. Encourage positive social interactions and engagement in daily programming.
* **Clinic & Operational Support**- Welcome members to the clinic, manage communications via phone and email, and assist with scheduling and member record updates to support smooth daily operations.
* **Team Collaboration -** Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team—including psychiatrists, therapists, dietitians, and primary care providers—to share observations and support coordinated member care. Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions about member engagement.
* **Member Advocacy & Resource Connection** - Identify members' ongoing needs and help connect them with community resources and supports that promote wellness.
* **Growth & Development -** Contribute to projects that support clinic growth and ongoing member success. Participate in training and supervision to build skills in mental health support, community resources, and member engagement.

**About You:**

You're a people-person who enjoys creating meaningful connections and helping others feel supported. Organized and proactive, you bring positive energy to member activities and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You enjoy being part of a multidisciplinary team and contributing ideas that help members and teammates succeed. Curious and eager to learn, you welcome feedback and are motivated to grow your skills in mental health support and community resources. Most of all, you lead with empathy and keep members at the heart of everything you do. If you're excited to help shape a new clinic and make a lasting impact in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**What You'll have:**

* Enrolled or recently graduated in a degree program related to mental health, such as pre-med, psychology, social work, or nursing
* Interest in mental health and desire to work with members with Severe Mental Illness
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment
* Detail-oriented and organized
* Comfortable working either one-on-one or in group settings, must possess excellent interpersonal skills and be able to adapt to changing situations
* Willingness to collaborate with others
* Well-organized and some experience planning and designing events and activities
* Basic computer skills are required
* The candidate should possess a holistic perspective of "health." Clinical Care Coordinators will demonstrate the ability to work effectively in a wide range of settings with people from diverse backgrounds, including members and co-workers

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980. Today Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD’s headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides both community development real estate facilities and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low-income US-born high-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the program supervisor, this position will serve low-income Workforce Innovation Opportunity Act (WIOA) participants to gain job placements, as well as manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs. This position is responsible for interfacing with local employers and training providers, external organizations, and the internal LFCD department, especially the America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) and Business Centers. This position is required to rotate at Berkeley Adult School and LFCD AJCC locations and reports to the Program Supervisor.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Conduct comprehensive participant assessments to develop individualized care management and employment plans that address physical health, behavioral health, substance use disorders, oral health, social determinants of health, career goals, and employment objectives.
* Perform community outreach and engagement activities, including attending resource fairs, distributing promotional materials, recruiting participants, and coordinating referrals to workforce programs, healthcare providers, and social service agencies.
* Facilitate workshops, program orientations, one-on-one and group counseling sessions, and educational activities focused on job readiness, career development, healthy living, self-sufficiency, and goal achievement.
* Assist participants in developing resumes, cover letters, and Individual Employment Plans (IEPs). Provide labor market information, career counseling, interview preparation, job referrals, job placement assistance, and retention services.
* Provide intensive case management services, including intake, eligibility determination, enrollment, assessment, documentation collection, career planning, referral coordination, and follow-up services. Support participants throughout their program participation and provide up to 12 months of employment retention services.
* Coordinate with training providers to facilitate enrollment in approved training programs and ensure Individual Training Account (ITA) requests and related documentation are submitted accurately and promptly.
* Maintain accurate participant records, including daily activity logs, case notes, service documentation, assessments, eligibility records, and data entry into CalJOBS, Care Management Systems (CMS), and other required databases.
* Deliver Community Supports services designed to address health-related social needs and improve participants' overall health, stability, and employment outcomes.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments; provide reminders; arrange transportation; accompany participants to critical medical appointments, community service appointments, and job interviews when appropriate; and assist in resolving barriers to participation.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with employers, healthcare providers, community-based organizations, educational institutions, and workforce development agencies to expand opportunities and resources for participants.
* Identify employment opportunities that offer competitive wages and benefits, conduct employer outreach and orientations, maintain employer relationships, and coordinate On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunities.
* Assist participants in accessing public benefits and supportive services, including Supplemental Security Income (SSI), CalFresh, cash assistance programs, workforce training resources, housing resources, and other community-based services.
* Provide transitional care coordination and employment retention services through participant follow-up, employer engagement, job tracking, and ongoing support to promote long-term employment success.
* Maintain current knowledge of Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), CalAIM, and related workforce and healthcare initiatives. Utilize community partnerships and available resources to improve participant outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, county, and agency regulations, including participant confidentiality requirements, HIPAA standards, workforce development regulations, and funding source requirements.
* Collaborate with colleges, career centers, training providers, healthcare organizations, and county agencies to facilitate participant enrollment, training approvals, service coordination, and successful outcomes.
* Communicate regularly with county departments, workforce development staff, and community partners to ensure program compliance, timely reporting, eligibility verification, and coordinated service delivery.
* Prepare and submit reports, case notes, performance outcomes, and other program documentation in accordance with agency, county, state, and funding source requirements.
* Provide administrative and programmatic support to Directors, Managers, Program Supervisors, and Site Supervisors as needed.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Human Services, Business Administration, Communications, Public Health, or a related field req

jobs.title: Customer Support Lead
jobs.description:
**About Pocket**

*At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.*

Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it.

We’ve built an AI-powered device that captures real-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices.

Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet.

**About the Role**

A customer might need help with a delivery, a device or a recording that has not synced. Good support needs to understand all three, and make the answer feel like it comes from one company.

You’ll own Pocket’s support function: the team, systems, quality and the AI agent already handling routine requests. You’ll also develop our customer community, turning existing engagement into useful conversation, advocacy and retention. This is hands-on work. You’ll coach people, configure the helpdesk and spend time with customers yourself.

**What You’ll Own**

* The AI support agent, knowledge base and automation that resolve routine needs and leave people able to focus on more complex cases.
* The support stack: helpdesk, integrations, routing and reporting.
* A distributed support and community team, including hiring, coaching, schedules and performance.
* Service quality and SLAs, alongside returns, warranties, order issues and escalations.
* The customer-feedback loop into product and operations, so recurring problems lead to fixes.
* Support measures such as deflection, cost per contact, response and resolution time, and CSAT, alongside community growth and its relationship to retention.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Support automation you have shipped, with evidence of how the results changed.
* Experience leading a support team of at least five people at a consumer company, ideally across hardware and software.
* The ability to troubleshoot device and software issues and translate clearly between customers and engineering.
* Comfort configuring tools, working with AI and running effective one-to-ones.
* Ownership of metrics and the systems behind them, without needing constant direction.
* Clear writing, good customer judgment and calm execution through launches, delays and spikes in demand.

**Why Join Pocket?**

You’ll shape a core part of the customer experience, with direct access to the founders and an existing team and support system to build on. You’ll be able to connect what customers tell you to changes in the product and the way the company works.

Compensation Range: $100K - $180K

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Environmental Program Leader – Hazardous Waste and Dangerous Goods Compliance will provide enterprise leadership, technical expertise, and continuous improvement across hazardous waste management and dangerous goods/hazmat transportation. In this highly visible role, the successful candidate will shape strategy, influence enterprise standards, and partner across sites and functions to strengthen compliance, standardize processes, improve environmental performance, and enable safe, reliable operations across the business.  
  
This role is ideal for a senior environmental leader who brings deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to drive impact across a complex, matrixed organization – translating complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and scalable processes that support both compliance excellence and operational execution.  
  
Success in this role requires a demonstrated ability to work across functional teams to achieve environmental and compliance objectives; strong problem-solving, project management, planning, organizational, time management, and analytical skills; and strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical environmental risks and requirements for non-technical audiences and influence positive behavioral change.  
  
This position will require up to 30% travel.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead enterprise direction for hazardous waste and dangerous goods compliance, including development and execution of short- and long-term goals and objectives for the EHS function.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise standard work for waste characterization, container management, labeling, storage, inspection, manifesting, and vendor qualification.
* Provide technical environmental support, practical guidance, and compliance solutions to GE Aerospace sites on hazardous waste and dangerous goods requirements.
* Monitor environmental programs for compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, and recommend business-level environmental policies, programs, and improvement initiatives.
* Represent GE Aerospace with governmental environmental agencies and trade/professional associations to support regulatory interpretation and compliance alignment.
* Track environmental performance metrics and drive actions that improve compliance and operating performance.
* Prepare comments on proposed environmental regulations and assess potential business impacts.
* Support sites with waste determinations, supporting documentation, analytical methods, and compliance execution.
* Participate in internal and external compliance audits and support audit readiness, inspection response, CAPA development, and closure verification for recurring or material findings.
* Provide governance for dangerous goods/hazmat transportation, including classification, packaging, marking, labeling, shipping papers, modal requirements, training controls, and shipment readiness reviews.
* Review trends from incidents, near misses, shipment errors, permit events, and vendor performance to identify risks and prioritize preventive actions.
* Lead practical training and coaching for site EHS operations, with a focus on common failure modes and effective controls.

* Partner with site EHS, legal, operations, quality, and logistics teams to interpret requirements and implement practical controls aligned to site processes.
* Estimated travel required is about 30%

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in environmental compliance, hazardous waste, dangerous goods, or related EHS disciplines.
* Knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to environmental operations in the geographic regions where GE Aerospace operates.
* Experience working with complex dangerous goods and hazardous waste regulations.

**Desired Characteristics and Experience:**

* 15+ years of industry experience
* Bachelor's degree in environmental or engineering, an advanced technical degree, and/or Professional Engineer (PE) license
* Experience with Hazardous Secondary Materials

* Enterprise mindset with the ability to connect regulatory requirements to practical business execution
* Ability to simplify complex technical topics into clear expectations and actions
* Passion for building capability, strengthening standard work, and driving sustainable results.

* Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
* Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
* Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
* Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
* Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

The base pay range for this position is $157,000 - $210,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 13, 2026.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary clinical follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

**This is a full-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20-22 per hour. We are offering two different shifts:**

* 8:00am - 4:30pm ET
* 9:30am - 6:00pm ET
* 10:30am - 7:00pm ET

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.

* Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
* Engage in cross-functional meetings and work collaboratively with others departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
* Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
* Manage the end-to-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.

* Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
* Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
* Initiate and resolve pharmacy-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
* Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
* 2+ years of high-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi-step processes where follow-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.

**BENEFITS**

*At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:*

* Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work-life blend.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
* Calibrate-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote-first ways of working, with the flexibility to work from any state.
* Competitive paid parental leave program to support new parents.

**OUR VALUES**

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

jobs.description:
**Operations ManagerLead the People, Processes, Systems, and Performance Behind a Growing Immigration Law Firm**

MRA Law Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Operations Manager** to lead the day-to-day performance, accountability, systems coordination, and continuous improvement of our Operations Department.

This is a leadership role for someone who knows how to turn expectations into execution.

The Operations Manager will oversee the operational teams responsible for supporting our clients, attorneys, and case production functions, from the first phone call through ongoing client communication, administrative support, document handling, internal operational requests, and systems-related execution.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, build accountability, analyze performance, improve processes, coordinate systems support, solve problems, and create an Operations Department that runs consistently without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership.

**What You Will Own**

**Operations Leadership & Team Management**

You will provide leadership and accountability across the Operations Department, including:

* Operations Team Lead
* Telephone Receptionist Team Lead and Receptionists
* Client CARE Team Lead and Client CARE Agents
* Virtual Assistant
* In-Office Administrative Assistant
* In-Office Legal Assistant
* Systems Administrator
* Systems Developer

You will establish clear expectations, ensure accountability, coach leaders and team members, identify performance issues early, and ensure the department has the structure, workflows, tools, and resources necessary to perform effectively.

You will be expected to manage both people and execution. This includes ensuring that team leaders are leading, frontline employees are meeting expectations, and systems-related support is helping the firm operate faster, cleaner, and more efficiently.

**Operational Performance & Accountability**

You will:

* Establish, monitor, and manage departmental and individual KPIs.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational performance.
* Hold team leaders accountable for the performance of their respective teams.
* Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring problems, and operational risks.
* Develop corrective action and coaching plans when performance falls below expectations.
* Ensure operational audits are completed and identified issues are addressed.
* Build an environment where ownership, follow-through, and accountability are part of everyday operations.

The current Operations framework measures department efficiency, workflow effectiveness, error reduction, client communication compliance, client satisfaction, complaints, procedure compliance, system usage, documentation accuracy, team KPI achievement, audits, issue-resolution time, process improvement, and operational risk identification.

**Systems, Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

The Operations Manager will play a key leadership role in ensuring the firm’s systems support the way the business actually needs to operate.

You will oversee the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer to ensure that systems, workflows, automations, reports, user access, troubleshooting, and technology improvements are properly prioritized and executed.

You will:

* Ensure operational systems are being used consistently and correctly.
* Translate operational needs into clear systems requirements.
* Coordinate with the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer on workflow improvements, automation opportunities, reporting needs, and system-related issues.
* Ensure system changes are aligned with operational goals and do not create unnecessary disruption.
* Monitor system usage, documentation accuracy, and compliance with required workflows.
* Identify gaps between process design, system capability, and actual team execution.
* Help prioritize technology improvements based on business impact, urgency, and scalability.
* Ensure systems-related projects are completed with clear ownership, timelines, testing, rollout, and follow-through.

This role does not require the Operations Manager to be a programmer. However, it does require someone who can understand operational problems, ask the right questions, manage systems-related priorities, and ensure technology supports performance instead of becoming another bottleneck.

**Client Experience**

Our Operations Department plays a major role in how clients experience MRA Law Group.

You will ensure:

* Client calls and communications are handled professionally and promptly.
* Reception and Client CARE teams consistently meet service expectations.
* Client concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately.
* Communication breakdowns do not become preventable client complaints.
* Operational issues contributing to cancellations, dissatisfaction, or refund exposure are identified and addressed.
* Client feedback and satisfaction trends are monitored and converted into practical operational improvements.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

We do not want someone who simply maintains existing processes. We want someone who asks:

**Why are we doing it this way, is it working, and can we do it better?**

You will:

* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs and workflows.
* Ensure consistent use of the firm’s case management system, trackers, and operational tools.
* Ensure tasks, communications, and activities are properly documented.
* Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, bottlenecks, process gaps, and ownership gaps.
* Translate operational problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Implement improvements and measure whether they actually worked.
* Identify operational risks before they become larger client, legal, financial, or business problems.

The right person for this role will not treat process improvement as theory. You should be able to move from observation to diagnosis, fro

jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Onboarding Manager is the primary point of contact and strategic driver for every hospital going live on Instinct. You are the project lead, the workflow expert, and the trusted advisor all in one — responsible for keeping implementations on track, on time, and on scope while earning the confidence of hospital leadership throughout the process.

This is not a task-management role. You bring executive presence, a strong sense of urgency, and the consultative skill to navigate a hospital's operational complexity while holding them accountable to the milestones that matter. You know that a delayed go-live is a delayed relationship, and you take that seriously.

You own end-to-end project coordination — from kick-off to go-live — working closely with Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, integrations, and internal teams to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience. Your strength is your ability to make every hospital feel like their implementation is the most important project you are running — even when you are managing several simultaneously

**What You'll Do ️**

**Project Leadership & Management**

* Project Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned onboarding projects from signed contract through go-live and handoff to the active CS team.
* Timeline Management: Build, manage, and enforce project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and accountability — targeting go-live within the 8-week SLA.
* Risk & Escalation: Identify project risks proactively and escalate effectively — to the hospital, to the Team Lead, and across internal teams — so nothing sits quietly off track.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate across Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, Integration partners, and Medical Review to keep all workstreams moving in sync.

**Customer Relationship & Consultative Approach**

* Trusted Advisor: Position yourself as a knowledgeable, credible partner throughout the project — not just a task tracker. Help hospital leaders see the full picture of what a successful go-live enables for their team.
* Executive Presence: Communicate confidently and credibly with practice owners, medical directors, and hospital administrators — matching your communication style to the audience while maintaining clarity and urgency.
* Workflow Development: Lead workflow discovery and design sessions with the hospital, translating their current clinical and operational processes into Instinct-configured workflows that fit how their team actually works.
* Sense of Urgency: Keep the hospital engaged and moving — because a delayed implementation is always a risk to go-live. You are skilled at creating accountability without creating friction.

**Technical & Product Coordination**

* Integration Setup: Own the coordination of integrations — including lab, imaging, and pharmacy partners — ensuring technical readiness aligns with the project timeline.
* Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Instinct's product capabilities and configuration options, serving as the go-to resource for workflow questions during onboarding.
* Training Coordination: Coordinate with Training Specialists to ensure training is scoped, scheduled, and delivered at the right point in the project — reinforcing adoption ahead of go-live.

**Who You Are ‍**

**Must Haves:**

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. Direct experience working in or closely with veterinary hospitals — clinical, operational, or administrative.
* **Project Management Experience:** 2–4+ years managing customer-facing implementation or onboarding projects, ideally in SaaS or health technology.
* **Instinct Software Familiarity:** Strongly preferred. Existing knowledge of Instinct's configuration and workflow capabilities accelerates ramp significantly.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated ability to manage relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization, including executives.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable coordinating software integrations, data requirements, and configuration discussions — even without deep technical expertise.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $65,000 - $80,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

*Instinct is an equal opportunity employer committed to equality and providing a pleasant work environment free from harassment

jobs.title: Product Quality Manager, Unsecured Lending
jobs.description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team**
============

Upstart’s Product Quality Oversight team builds and operates the first line of defense quality oversight program for unsecured lending, including personal loans, small-dollar loans, and cash line. The team assesses whether lending decisions, disclosures, customer-facing workflows, and servicing outputs operate as intended and meet regulatory and internal policy requirements.

As the Product Quality Manager, Unsecured Lending at Upstart, you will lead end-to-end quality testing for assigned regulatory areas and help shape a scalable, data-driven oversight program. You’ll define risk-based testing coverage, partner with Engineering to design and validate automated monitoring, and work across teams to resolve control gaps. This is an individual contributor role.

**How you’ll make an impact**
=============================

* Lead testing for assigned regulatory areas from planning through reporting, defining risk-based coverage, sampling approaches, test scripts, and documented conclusions.
* Set testing priorities and timelines for assigned areas, and coordinate testers' work to meet them.
* Translate regulatory requirements into testable attributes and criteria; update test scripts and coverage as regulations or products change; and decide when to re-scope testing or seek Compliance or Legal interpretation as facts change.
* Lead control design walkthroughs to understand the end-to-end process, including dependencies across systems, teams, and third parties; challenge whether controls are designed to address the risk, and set the testing approach.
* Evaluate whether lending controls operate as intended across origination, servicing, and collections; identify systemic gaps and escalate findings supported by evidence.
* Partner with Engineering on automated and AI-assisted monitoring requirements, verifying rule logic, testing populations, outputs, and missed exceptions before relying on results.
* Lead validation after product or process changes, review and reperform testers’ work, and help maintain consistent methods and audit-ready documentation.
* Translate findings and root causes into actionable recommendations; work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk to advance remediation and support reviews by second-line testing and Internal Audit.
* Help improve the oversight program and guide other testers while using approved AI tools responsibly, verifying AI-assisted conclusions against source requirements and manual checks.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in compliance testing, quality control or assurance, internal audit, or regulatory examination in consumer lending.
* Experience independently designing and leading end-to-end quality or compliance testing for consumer lending products, systems, or transactions.
* Experience developing and applying risk-based sampling methods, standardized testing criteria, and documented conclusions under consumer financial regulations such as TILA/Reg Z, ECOA/Reg B, FCRA, EFTA/Reg E, FDCPA/Reg F, or UDAAP.
* Experience analyzing testing populations, control results, or automated monitoring outputs to assess completeness and identify exceptions.

* Knowledge of automated lending platforms, digital lending products, or credit decisioning systems.
* Experience with quality oversight for unsecured installment loans or lines of credit.
* Experience designing or validating automated or AI-assisted quality monitoring, including checks for missed exceptions.
* Ability to influence cross-functional remediation and communicate control assessments to stakeholders with different areas of expertise.

Client Management

Supporting and facilitating weekly client meetings, owning the agenda, minutes and action items. Ensuring all appropriate attendees are invited and attending.

Ensuring all documentation including systems have current client information and updates.

Building and maintaining strong operational and systems knowledge, and risk mitigation.

Establishing trust and credibility with clients and consultants as a strategic partner by ensuring accurate and timely communications and issue resolution.

Participating in process improvement and annual activities, and administrative duties as required.

Performance Management & Revenue Retention

Leading client performance reporting, translating data into actionable, strategic insights that influence client decisions and demonstrate measurable value.

Leveraging data insights to develop, maintain and execute strategic accounts plans focused on retention, growth and satisfaction.

Reinforcing the Quantum story and value by protecting and elevating the member experience, ensuring client confidence, strengthening membership satisfaction, and fueling long‑term revenue growth.

Cross Functional Alignment

Working with the dedicated implementation team as needed to successfully onboard new clients.

Managing cross-functional operational deliverables, based on client needs, to ensure client and Quantum success. Other duties as assigned

Education: Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience.

Experience: 5+ years' relevant experience in client success, consulting, strategic account management, or other applicable area, preferably in healthcare benefits, consulting or related industries.

Strong critical thinking, verbal and written communication, and in-person presentation skills.

Proficient PC skills, including MS Office Suite and CRM software, Salesforce, ServiceNow experience preferred.

Experience with creating and maintaining: Account Plans, Health Score Updates, General Account Status.

Comfortable navigating complex conversations, influencing stakeholders, and driving alignment across internal and external teams.

Ability to translate data into a persuasive, compelling story with clear, actionable insights and recommendations.

25% of travel required as needed – cyclical depending on client needs.

Join the team as our next Customer Success Manager on Twilio’s Twilio team.

**About the job**

At Twilio, we believe companies should be able to send their data wherever they want, whenever they want, with no fuss. We make this easy with a single platform that collects, stores, filters, transforms, and sends data to hundreds of business tools with the flip of a switch. More recently, we also developed the ability to let customers enrich their data in real time using computations they specify. Our goal is to make it easy to understand, extract value, and protect the integrity of data. We are creating a world where engineers spend their time working on their core product, letting us take care of the complexities of processing their customer data reliably at scale. We’re in the running to take over the entire customer data ecosystem, and we need the best people to take the market.

The Customer Success Management team at Twilio is the central touchpoint for our customers, orchestrating the post-sales customer lifecycle in partnership with professional services, sales and support. The team manages the customer relationship, coordinates internally within Twilio, drives product adoption and guides the customer to take full advantage of our ecosystem. **The Role**
------------

We're hiring another Customer Success Manager to own a book of business across our Pro package clients. You'll be the main point of contact for your accounts from onboarding through renewal, responsible for adoption, retention, and growth. This is a high-ownership role, so you'll touch everything from day-one onboarding to churn saves to surfacing product gaps back to the team.

* Pull and interpret usage and subscription data to prioritize where to spend your time, and report on your book's health
* Capture customer feedback and feature requests, turn them into clear product asks, and track them through to resolution
* Support Reacher Plus clients where managed service and software overlap
* Keep account context, notes, and next steps clean and current
* Join demo calls as the platform expert with the sales team whenever needed

**You'll Be Successful If You**
-------------------------------

* Have 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role
* Have hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop, including strategy, affiliate programs, and automation tools; agency background preferred
* Are a strong communicator who can build rapport quickly and maintain trust over time
* Are comfortable managing clients
* Are highly organized with a bias toward follow-through and accountability
* Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where speed and scrappiness are key

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Black Mountain Dynamics delivers managed IT and cybersecurity services, and the Technical Account Manager is the face of BMX to every client after the sale closes. You'll own the relationship and the client experience. Customer Success at BMX is early-stage, so you'll build the playbook, not just run it. The frameworks you create for onboarding, success planning, QBRs, and renewals will become the standard for how BMX scales its client relationships.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Customer relationship ownership across the assigned book — success plans, executive communication, renewal risk visibility, and the client's overall experience with BMX.
* Client onboarding coordination: the administrative, documentation, and client-facing experience of bringing new clients live. You partner with Project Management on sequencing and Service Delivery on technical execution so the client experiences onboarding as one seamless motion. You establish the definition of done and continuously improve the process with reusable templates.
* Client offboarding coordination in the same partnership model — access removals, documentation, and final handoffs clean from the customer's perspective.
* Success planning: a living success plan for each account capturing business goals, desired outcomes, account health, and how BMX delivers against them.
* Relationship mapping: a current map of executive sponsors, champions, and decision-makers at each client — you know who matters and why.
* QBR ownership: the agenda, roadmap narrative, and strategic message of each business review. Service Delivery brings operational reporting; you ensure it lands inside a coherent story.
* VIP cadence and stakeholder communications across the assigned book — clear, timely, and always ahead of the surprise.
* Renewals and risk: forecasting, risk identification, and renewal close for assigned clients. You own escalations where the issue is fundamentally about trust, executive pressure, or retention risk.
* Expansion identification: qualifying growth opportunities within existing accounts (additional services, sites, users, project work). You listen for the next great BMX engagement on every interaction.
* Client-facing documentation: own the client-facing documentation ecosystem to ensure navigating support and accessing information is intuitive for clients. Partner closely with Service Delivery to ensure external resources accurately reflect actual operational workflows.
* Voice of the customer: capturing and surfacing client feedback to inform BMX's service improvements, automation roadmap, and tooling decisions.
* Scope and expectation setting: defining clear project timelines, priorities, and boundaries with clients based on their actual environment before locking in a technical path.

**WHAT YOU WON'T OWN**

Clear boundaries protect this role from scope creep. The following responsibilities sit with other functions and are not yours to absorb:

* Service execution — triage, dispatch, ticket quality, SLA performance, on-call rotation, and service-execution escalations sit with Service Delivery.
* Technical execution on onboarding, offboarding, or deployments — the technical work sits with Service Delivery; you own the administrative and client-facing side.
* Project plans, timelines, dependencies, and project status reporting — those sit with Technical Project Management.
* Service desk overflow — escalations come to you for relationship risk, not ticket execution.
* New logo sales — new business acquisition is owned by the CEO.
* Backstop for unstaffed responsibilities — new scope is added via explicit conversation, not by default.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Core Requirements**

* Experience in a customer-facing role at an MSP, MSSP, IT services firm, or similar B2B technology services business, with comfort coordinating across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — demonstrated ability to build and maintain repeatable processes rather than relying on tribal knowledge; comfort owning the administrative spine of cross-functional work.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to translate technical context into business outcomes for executive audiences.
* Comfort shaping a role as it evolves and operating through influence rather than direct authority.
* Confidence in owning the room for high-stakes presentations to executives and decision-makers.
* Proficient with ticketing, documentation, and collaboration platforms, and able to pick up new systems quickly.

**Strong Plus**

* Prior CSM, account management, or service delivery experience inside an MSP or MSSP environment.
* Technical literacy — familiarity with networking, security, and cloud concepts sufficient to coordinate confidently with engineers and clients. Deep technical execution isn't required; informed conversation is.
* Exposure to customer success frameworks: success planning, health scoring, QBR design, and/or formal MSP frameworks.
* ITIL Foundation, customer success certifications, or similar.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA and Hudu.

**WHO YOU ARE**

Relationship-first. You measure success by whether clients feel taken care of — not just whether tickets get closed. You carry the full weight of the BMX relationship on every interaction.

Operationally disciplined. You build systems and templates so the next onboarding is better than the last. You don't reinvent the wheel — you document it so no one has to.

Proactively communicative. You believe clients should never hear bad news from someone other than you, and never be surprised. World-class NOC standards apply to every message you send.

Cross-functional without becoming a bottleneck. You translate client priorities into clear inputs for engineering and project teams — connecting the right people without becoming the person everything routes through.

Comfortable with ambiguity. This role is still being built. You'll make good calls without a detailed pl

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Account Manager will manage a high-volume portfolio of customers across North America. This role is responsible for driving renewals, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities while ensuring strong customer engagement and retention. The ideal candidate is a proactive, customer-focused professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can execute scalable motions to deliver measurable value to customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Management & Customer Engagement**

* Manage a large book of accounts with recurring revenue models, ensuring timely renewals and account health.
* Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct regular outreach to identify growth opportunities and mitigate churn risk.

**Revenue Growth & Retention**

* Achieve revenue targets through renewals, upsell, and cross-sell within assigned accounts.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management in CRM systems.
* Partner with Customer Success to ensure seamless onboarding and ongoing product utilization.

**Operational Excellence**

* Adhere to sales process discipline, CRM hygiene, and account governance best practices.
* Leverage data and insights to prioritize outreach and improve efficiency.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance inside sales scalability.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Professional Services to deliver customer value and support go-to-market initiatives.
* Represent the voice of customers internally to inform product enhancements and service offerings.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in inside sales, account management, or customer success within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Proven success managing high-volume, lower ARR portfolios with recurring revenue models.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding revenue and retention goals.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in asset management, facilities, operations, or real estate-focused software a plus.
* Familiarity with inside sales motions and scalable account management practices.

**Fortive Corporation Overview**

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Personal development and becoming the best you is all about growth and exploring new skills and opportunities – both in and out of the office. At Accruent, we call this Grow Without Limits, and we’re proud to offer each of our employees the resources, coaching and support necessary to achieve Growth Without Limits in their personal and professional lives. Explore where the path takes you.

With U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas, Accruent serves over 5,000 customers in a wide range of industries in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@fortive.com.

The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 61,500.00 - 102,700.00.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge; skills; experience; and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. LocaliQ is looking for a client-focused, data-driven Account Manager who loves digital marketing and building strong customer relationships.
  
In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted marketing partner to our clients, helping them get the most from their advertising investment. You’ll oversee campaigns across channels including paid search, programmatic display, social media, digital and print media, using performance insights to recommend strategies that support each client’s business goals.
  
You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, campaign optimization, digital solutions, and ad operations teams to deliver an exceptional client experience. If you enjoy combining relationship management, digital marketing strategy, and data-driven problem solving, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact across a diverse portfolio of businesses.
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Own and grow client relationships, serving as the primary post-sale point of contact and trusted marketing advisor.
* Partner with Sales and campaign optimization teams to understand client goals and develop strategies designed to maximize performance and ROI.
* Manage client expectations and maintain proactive, transparent communication throughout the campaign lifecycle.
* Lead regular performance conversations, translating campaign data and marketing metrics into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
* Evaluate campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve results across paid search, display, social, digital, and print channels.
* Recommend new strategies, products, and tactics based on evolving client needs and marketing trends.
* Help clients understand not just what their campaigns are doing, but why it matters to their business.
* Collaborate with internal digital solutions, optimization, and ad operations teams to resolve challenges and deliver against client objectives.
* Ensure clients receive a cohesive marketing experience across multiple channels and solutions.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships, improve campaign outcomes, and support long-term retention and growth.
* Stay current on emerging digital marketing trends, platforms, technologies, and best practices.

What You’ll Bring
  

* 3+ years of client-facing account management or customer success experience, ideally within advertising, media, marketing, or a related industry.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with digital advertising campaigns.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels such as Google Ads/PPC, programmatic display, paid social, email marketing, lead generation, and digital analytics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance data and turn it into recommendations clients can easily understand and act on.
* Strong relationship-building skills with the confidence to lead client conversations and navigate challenging situations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive, curious mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort working collaboratively across Sales, Operations, Optimization, and other internal teams.
* Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint.
* Google Ads and/or Google Analytics experience or certification is highly valued.

You’ll Thrive Here If You
  

* Love building relationships and becoming a trusted resource for your clients.
* Get excited about using data to uncover opportunities and improve marketing performance.
* Can translate complex digital marketing concepts into simple, compelling client conversations.
* Enjoy collaborating with multiple teams to solve problems and get results.
* Are comfortable in an environment where technology, products, and client needs continue to evolve.
* Take ownership, communicate proactively, and look for solutions before problems escalate.
* Are naturally curious about what drives customer engagement and business growth.

Education & Experience
  
A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred. We also value relevant professional experience and demonstrated success in digital marketing and client relationship management.

jobs.description:
What’s so special about us?
  
Here at Hoffmaster, your ideas don’t just get heard, they help shape what’s next. Your growth is supported, your contributions are valued, and your work plays a role in creating moments people enjoy every day.
  
From paper plates and napkins to paper straws, party supplies, and food wrap, Hoffmaster is a leader in the tableware industry.
  
Create. Collaborate. Elevate….your dining table and your career!
  
About the Role
  
The National Account Manager is responsible for driving profitable growth within the Walmart business through strategic account management, customer relationship development, and innovative product solutions. jobs.title: Field Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**About HG Insights**
---------------------

HG Insights gives B2B go-to-market teams the data to find, size and win their best markets. Our platform covers technology installs, IT spend, intent and buyer signals, delivered through the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, and our MCP server and AI agents. Through TrustRadius, we also bring the Customer Voice to buyers and vendors.

**The team:** Field and Customer Enablement sits in Product Marketing. We own how HG teaches its product, inside and out: training for our sellers and CSMs, and the HG Insights Academy for customers and partners. You'll join a team led by Sam Brace, alongside a Customer Education Manager and two Enablement Interns.

**The role**
------------

As Field Enablement Manager, you'll run the day-to-day enablement program for everyone at HG Insights who faces customers: Account Executives, Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), BDRs, and Customer Success Managers. You keep the weekly GTM Enablement session, new-hire onboarding, and launch readiness running, so sellers and CSMs always know what's new, why it matters, and how to show it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll build the content, host the sessions, and run the programs, working closely with Sales and CS leaders and with Product Marketing. You report to Sam Brace, Director of Field Enablement and Customer Education.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run the weekly GTM Enablement session.** Plan, build and host it each week, then publish the recording, slides and highlights to the global GTM Slack channel.
* **Own Flockjay programs.** Build and assign courses, assessments and hands-on assignments. Track completion and share leaderboards and team breakouts with Sales and CS leaders.
* **Onboard and ramp new hires.** Run onboarding and ramp plans for AEs, SDRs/BDRs and CSMs, including internal certificate and badging programs on the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, MCP and AI Agents, and our Customer Voice and TrustRadius offerings.
* **Make launches field-ready.** Work with Product Marketing to turn launch materials into talk tracks, demo scripts, objection handling and battlecards, so the field is trained before each release.
* **Build CSM-specific enablement.** Create adoption plays, renewal and expansion conversation guides, and guidance on positioning HG Insider sessions and Academy classes with accounts.
* **Keep the content library current.** Update the enablement library after each release and retire outdated assets.
* **Report on impact.** Share monthly completion, certification and ramp metrics, and bring gaps to Sam and GTM leaders.
* **Support live events.** Help run enablement at sales kickoff and other in-person training as needed.
* **Direct intern work** on field enablement tasks.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 3 to 5 years in sales or customer success enablement, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data company.
* Hands-on experience with an enablement platform such as Flockjay, Highspot, Seismic or Mindtickle.
* Confidence presenting live to sales and CS audiences, and a track record of building content that reps actually use.
* Comfort editing video content with production and post-production tools such as Descript or Camtasia.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and explain it in business terms.
* Clear written English and the ability to work regular hours that overlap with US business hours, since live sessions run on US time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience as a quota-carrying seller or CSM.
* Knowledge of GTM data, technographics or intent products.
* Experience using AI tools (such as Claude) to speed up content and reporting.
* Experience running onboarding or certification programs for a global sales team.

**What we offer/Benefits**
--------------------------

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.  
  
We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Training Specialist is a cross-trained product expert who delivers hands-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.

You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.

You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

**What You'll Do ️**

**Training Delivery**

* Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go-live readiness.
* Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
* Cross-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
* Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

**Account Intelligence & Preparation**

* Pre-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
* Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
* Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

**Team Coordination & Travel**

* Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
* Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in-person where context and environment make it more effective.
* Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
* Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

**Who You Are ‍**

Must Haves:

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
* **Instinct Software Experience:** Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
* **Customer-Facing Training or Education:** 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast-paced environment.
* **CRM & Call Intelligence Tools:** Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
* **Travel Availability:** Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $55,000 - $70,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
